---
title: "James Receives NSF CAREER Award to Study Urban Flood Infrastructure"
description: "James received a five-year NSF CAREER award to study how cities can combine flood and stormwater infrastructure to manage flood risk."
categories: News
date: 2026-05-12
---

James received a five-year CAREER award from the National Science Foundation to study how cities can combine green and traditional infrastructure to manage urban flood risk.

Read the [Rice Engineering story](https://engineering.rice.edu/news/doss-gollin-receives-national-science-foundations-career-award) or the [NSF award abstract](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=2543303).
